Futur I with Werden: German B1 Exercises

Study four German examples with English meanings, then try four questions and check the explained answers.

B1 level4 worked examples4 practice questions

Independent practice by Klarweg. Not an official Goethe exam or assessment.

Understand the rule

Futur I combines a present-tense form of werden with a bare infinitive at the end: Die Lieferung wird morgen ankommen. The auxiliary agrees with the subject. German also uses the present for many future plans; Futur I is one option, not a requirement whenever tomorrow appears.

Common mistake to avoid

Werden + infinitive forms Futur I; werden + past participle can form a passive. Do not replace ankommen with angekommen in this future pattern.

How to practise: read the examples once, cover the English meanings and try explaining the choice aloud. Next, complete all four questions before opening their answers.

Four German examples with English meanings

Pay attention to the exact article, verb position or ending described in the rule.

Worked example 1Die Lieferung wird morgen ankommen.The delivery will arrive tomorrow.
Worked example 2Wir werden den Vertrag nächste Woche prüfen.We will check the contract next week.
Worked example 3Du wirst die Adresse bald finden.You will find the address soon.
Worked example 4Ihr werdet den Unterschied merken.You all will notice the difference.

Practice: fill in the gaps

Use the present-tense form of werden to complete Futur I. Keep the final infinitive. Try each question before opening the answer. A dash (—) means no word is needed. Where another answer is possible, the explanation notes it. These are self-check exercises, not exam scoring.

Question 1. Ich ___ dich am Sonntag besuchen. (werden)

Show answer and explanation for question 1

Answer: werde

Ich takes werde; besuchen stays at the end.

Question 2. Der Laden ___ bald schließen. (werden)

Show answer and explanation for question 2

Answer: wird

A singular subject takes wird.

Question 3. Ihr ___ die Ergebnisse später bekommen. (werden)

Show answer and explanation for question 3

Answer: werdet

The ihr form is werdet.

Question 4. Wir ___ im Juni umziehen. (werden)

Show answer and explanation for question 4

Answer: werden

Wir takes werden in the present-tense auxiliary slot.

Revise it so it sticks

Return to this lesson tomorrow and complete the four gaps without looking at the rule. Then write two of your own sentences using today's pattern. Check whether the subject, case and verb position match the explanation.
